definitions.explanation: Having a shape that is narrow in width relative to its length. Describes objects, shapes, or body parts that are stretched out and slim.

examples.japanese: {細長|ほそなが}い⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A long, narrow corridor stretches ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細長|ほそなが}い⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細長|ほそなが}い⟦{島国|しまぐに}→島国：12339_shimaguni⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan is a long, narrow island nation.

notes:
- {細長|ほそなが}い → {細長|ほそなが}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative)
- {細長|ほそなが}い → {細長|ほそなが}く (adverbial form)
- {細長|ほそなが}い → {細長|ほそなが}かった (past)

FORMS:
Compound adjective formed from ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧ (thin) + ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long).

USAGE:
Describes objects, spaces, or body parts that are notably elongated and slim.
- {細長|ほそなが}い⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ (elongated shape)
- {細長|ほそなが}い⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (long, narrow face)
- {細長|ほそなが}い⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ (long, narrow building)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長細|ながぼそ}い→長細い：20307_nagabosoi⟧ - Same meaning, less common variant
- ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧ - Just thin/narrow, without the length component
